newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Cosmos says market share rises to 17 pct.
newsitem.headline: Cosmos says market share rises to 17 pct.

text.p: Cosmos Bottling Corp said on Monday its market share in the Philippines had grown to 17 percent in the first month of the year, from an average market share of 13 percent last year.
The company said the 17 percent market share made it the second biggest softdrinks maker in the country.
Cosmos, which is a subsidiary of RFM Corp, manufactures low-priced softdrinks.
Cosmos recently acquired two local softdrinks brands which are strong in central and southern Philippines.
The local soft beverage market is dominated by Coca-Cola Bottlers Philippines Inc, a joint venture of San Miguel Corp and Coca-Cola Co.
The other player is Pepsi Cola Products Philippines Inc, a unit of PepsiCo Inc.

"We are very happy about this development because this will validate the soundness of Cosmos' strength and the wisdom of continually investing in growth," Cosmos president Jose Concepcion III said in a statement.
RFM has invested about 3.0 billion in Cosmos' expansion in the past three years.
